title: Require complete bridge-control coverage in the PR741 binder
body:
The PR741 binding checker currently accepts any 18 bridge-control records with `rejected: true`, without checking their `omit_bridge` identities. Replacing one bridge ID with a duplicate therefore still produces PASS even though one omission control is no longer represented.

Require the 18 records to cover integer bridge IDs 0 through 17 exactly once, with literal true rejection flags. Reordering remains valid. The patch adds regression tests using copies of the committed composed-replay evidence and updates the selected record's checker hash. Existing tests and archived mathematical results are unchanged.

Tested locally against `7ee02b7c96d85f22b38d28bd7ed49bb8c1aeb261` with Python 3.12.15 in a restricted Linux container:

- The unchanged checker accepts 25 malformed cases in the new tests; genuine and reordered receipts pass.
- With the repair, all 30 test definitions and 195 subtests across the new bridge controls, existing PR741 binding, selected-record, and reconciliation modules pass.
- The PR741 binding CLI, selected-record check, and full PR reconciliation pass. The selected value remains `1661202643272239/1000000000000000000`.

This validates the coverage recorded in a saved receipt; it does not independently prove that each producer-side test was executed. The full supplier reconstruction and cold replay were not rerun, and no new mathematical result is claimed.

Prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance.
